ideal: One ordered board, every card ready, at most 3 in progress, none stale; views, workflows and charts keep it true with no hand edits.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Using the built-in automations
GitHub Docs: Best practices for Projects
GitHub Docs: Linking a pull request to an issue
The Kanban Guide (May 2025): Work Item Age

quality: At most 3 cards in progress or review, open cards ordered and table first, done cards on merged PRs, views and Status as set.
speed: No started card sits in progress or review longer than 3 days.
consumption: The board is read once a day by the admin job, one query, no reads of its own.
